# fast_rspec

> Ruby gem: one Gemfile line replaces the whole test stack. Lean, API-compatible reimplementations of RSpec (core, expectations, mocks, rails) and Minitest (5 + 6, incl. Rails' `ActiveSupport::TestCase`), parallel on every CPU core by default, with WebMock, VCR, Faker, database cleaning, SimpleCov and (later) FactoryBot rebuilt in and auto-configured. shoulda-matchers and Capybara/Cuprite stay upstream and are auto-wired. Zero runtime dependencies. Rails and plain Ruby. CRuby (fork pool + C extension), JRuby and TruffleRuby (thread pool + pure-Ruby twin).

**Status (2026-10-31): design phase — nothing below works yet.** This file describes the target contract so agents write compatible code from day one. Each section says which roadmap milestone ships it (`docs/idea/11-roadmap.md`).

Install: `gem 'fast_rspec'` in the `:development, :test` group. Remove the gems it replaces. MIT. Source: https://github.com/developerz-ai/fast_rspec. Maintained by developerz.ai (AI maintainer agent: triage, review, merges, releases).

## Rules for agents writing tests in a fast_rspec project

1. Write normal RSpec or Minitest. Same DSL, matchers, assertions, hooks, CLI flags, exit codes, output. Never `require` anything fast_rspec-specific in a spec/test.
2. Don't add `rspec-*`, `minitest-reporters`, `parallel_tests`, `webmock`, `vcr`, `faker`, `database_cleaner*` or `simplecov` to the Gemfile — they're built in. Keep `shoulda-matchers`, `capybara`, `cuprite` if you use them; fast_rspec configures them.
3. Don't write `test/support` / `spec/support` boilerplate for: FactoryBot syntax methods, WebMock `disable_net_connect!`, VCR cassette dir, shoulda `integrate`, Devise test helpers, time helpers, `parallelize(workers: :number_of_processors)`. It's automatic. If you do write it, yours wins.
4. Tests run on all cores, each worker with its own DB, Redis DB, tmp dir and ports. Don't share state through files, class variables or ENV between tests. Fork-safety is ours; order-independence is yours.
5. Reproduce a failure with the one-line command fast_rspec prints (seed + that worker's files).

## Commands (M1–M2)

| Do | Command |
|---|---|
| Run everything (RSpec + Minitest) on all cores | `bundle exec fast_rspec` |
| RSpec | `bundle exec rspec`, `rspec spec/x_spec.rb:12`, every upstream flag |
| Minitest / Rails | `bin/rails test`, `bin/rails test test/x_test.rb:12`, `rake test` |
| Serial | `-n 1` or `FAST_RSPEC_WORKERS=1` |
| Fewer workers | `FAST_RSPEC_WORKERS=4` |
| Pool | `FAST_RSPEC_POOL=fork\|thread\|spawn` (default: fork on CRuby, thread on JRuby/TruffleRuby) |
| Coverage | `COVERAGE=1 <any command>` (merged across workers) |
| Debug wiring | `FAST_RSPEC_DEBUG=1` (logs what was auto-configured) |
| Force pure-Ruby twin | `FAST_RSPEC_DISABLE_EXT=1` |

## Configuration (optional)

```ruby
# spec/spec_helper.rb or test/test_helper.rb — only if you need to change a default
FastRspec.configure do |c|
  c.workers = 8
  c.batteries.disable :vcr, :capybara
end
```

`FAST_RSPEC_DISABLE=vcr,capybara` does the same from the environment.

## Batteries

| Battery | API | Milestone | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| RSpec | rspec-core / -expectations / -mocks / -rails 3.13 | M2–M3 | `.rspec` honored; rails type inference |
| Minitest | minitest 5.2x + 6.x, `ActiveSupport::TestCase` | M1, M3 | `parallelize` routed to the pool |
| WebMock | webmock 3.x | M4 | `disable_net_connect!(allow_localhost: true)`, reset per test |
| VCR | vcr 6.x | M4 | only if the app already uses cassettes; atomic cassette writes |
| Faker | faker 3.x | M4 | deterministic per seed + worker; data loaded lazily |
| DB cleaning | database_cleaner 2.x | M3 | transactional tests; per-worker DB cloned from a template |
| SimpleCov | simplecov 0.22 | M5 | starts before app code; results merged across workers |
| FactoryBot | factory_bot 6.x | M6 (upstream wired until then) | definitions found, syntax methods included |
| shoulda / Capybara / Cuprite / Devise / Sidekiq | upstream gems | M5 | auto-wired: integrate, ports, browsers, helpers, fake queues |

## Pitfalls

- `parallelize(workers: 1)` or `-n 1` disables parallelism; a hard-coded worker count in `test_helper.rb` is honored.
- Tests that depend on run order fail under any seed; fast_rspec just exposes them faster. Use the printed repro and `fast_rspec bisect`.
- JRuby/TruffleRuby thread pool: tests that stub process-global state (`stub_const`, `allow_any_instance_of`, `$stdout` swaps) run in the spawn pool automatically.
- Upstream behavior differences, if any, are listed in `docs/idea/parity-divergences.md`. Report others as a "Compatibility gap" issue.
